name: Google Ads 3 — Conversion Tracking Audit + Setup

parameters.content:
## Conversion Audit
Every bid decision depends on conversions being real. This checks: 60-second call minimum, one-per-click counting for leads, silent tags, GA4 + tag double counting, auto-tagging, enhanced conversions.

It also **creates the offline lead-stage actions** Workflow 4 needs. Fixes apply only when `AUTO_FIX = true` inside **Audit Tracking**.
